Split Protocol: For every seed, first reserve 20% stratified holdout; then split the remaining 80% into 80% training and 20% validation, yielding 64/16/20.
Fixed Hyperparameters: Hyperparameters were copied from the seed-42 validation-safe tuning stage.
Threshold Selection: Performed independently on each seed's validation set.
Security Objective: Maximum validation F2 subject to FPR <= 5%
Limitations: The complete hyperparameter search was not repeated for every seed.
The multi-seed analysis focuses on the two final objective-specific candidates rather than all sixteen baseline models.
The experiment measures split and training robustness but not cross-dataset generalization.
